summary: Implemented E3052, E3053 and E3054 as keyword rules in src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/ (ServiceNetworkConfiguration.py, TaskDefinitionAwsVpc.py, ServiceFargate.py) with unit tests test_service_network_configuration.py, test_task_definition_aws_vpc.py and test_service_fargate.py under test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/. Results: ECS unit tests 70 passed; test/unit/rules plus test_rules_collections.py 986 passed. Integration: 14 passed, 4 failed. The same 4 fail on the untouched base checkout (test_formatters::test_junit, test_quickstart_templates::test_templates, and both tests in test_quickstart_templates_non_strict.py), so they are not caused by this change. The openshift quickstart template produces no E3052-E3054 hits; its exit code difference comes from other rules, not diagnosed further. Notes: tests need PYTHONPATH=src because the venv's cfnlint resolves to the base checkout; ruff and black are not in the venv, so formatting was checked by hand (no lines over 88 columns); test/unit/module/formatters cannot be collected because defusedxml is missing from the venv and was not installed. Nothing was committed.
